headline: Bitcoin is holding around $80,000 ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision, as crypto company earnings start today and a string of wallet and exchange security problems keeps users on alert.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds around $80,000 into Wednesday's Fed decision
stories.summary: Bitcoin dipped to its lowest level since mid-September on Monday, then got back just above $80,000 by Tuesday morning in Asia. Economists widely expect the Fed to hold rates on Wednesday. The latest US spot bitcoin fund data shows two days of heavy selling late last week, and a large batch of bitcoin options expires on Friday.
points: Bitcoin slipped to $79,332 overnight into Monday, its lowest since 18 September, per CryptoTicker.
At 9:30am Korea time Tuesday (00:30 UTC) bitcoin was $80,138.79, up 0.09% from the previous day, and ether $2,324.22, per IT Times citing CoinMarketCap.

US spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) lost $635.6M on Thu 22 Oct and $137.9M on Fri 23 Oct, but the five-day week still ended net positive, per Coin Turk citing Farside. Monday's full flows were not confirmed this run.
94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect the Fed to hold, per Newsquawk.
Bitcoin options worth about $12.2B (notional) expire on Deribit on Friday 30 Oct, with 'max pain' at $79,000, per CryptoTicker. Max pain is not a price target.

stories.title: Crypto company earnings week starts today with Galaxy and Robinhood
stories.summary: Galaxy reports before the US market opens today and Robinhood after it closes; Strategy follows on Thursday. Strategy, which holds 848,517 BTC, bought none last week and holds a shareholder vote on Wednesday.
points: Galaxy reports before the Nasdaq opens on Tue 27 Oct, with an investor call at 8:30am ET (19:30 Bangkok), per its announcement.
Robinhood reports after the close on Tue 27 Oct with a call at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Wed Bangkok); in its last quarter crypto revenue fell 38% to $100M, per TradingKey.
Strategy bought no bitcoin from 19 to 25 Oct, still holds 848,517 BTC, and bought back about $204.9M of its STRC preferred shares instead, per The Block.
Strategy's special shareholder meeting is Wed 28 Oct at 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok); the main proposal would let its preferred shares pay dividends daily, per its SEC filing.
Strategy reports after the US close on Thu 29 Oct with a webinar at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Fri Bangkok), per Strategy.

stories.title: Security watch: Electrum bug, CoinDCX's $16M loss, a Solana bot drain and phishing emails
stories.summary: Several recent attacks hit ordinary users rather than big protocols. A bug in the Electrum bitcoin wallet let rogue servers steal funds when users sped up a payment; version 4.8.3 fixes it. India's CoinDCX confirmed a $16M loss. The Solana trading bot Bloom was drained of about $954K, and wallet maker Foundation warned of phishing emails sent from its own domains.
points: Electrum 4.8.3 adds signature checks for unconfirmed transactions; the bug was disclosed 24 Oct and some servers were actively exploiting it. Update only from electrum.org, per CryptoTicker.
CoinDCX lost 15.99M USDT (about $16M) on 21 Oct after its CEO first called it a false alarm; it says user balances are unaffected, per Decrypt.
About 9,408 SOL (about $954,000) was taken from 49 wallets belonging to 9 Bloom users; Bloom says it will fully reimburse them, per Blockchain Reporter.
Attackers used compromised Cloudflare API keys to send fake emails from Foundation's domains; Foundation says funds on its Passport wallets are safe, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Ripple's Swell conference opens in New York
briefs.summary: Swell runs 27-29 Oct at The Shed with about 1,500 attendees expected; Cross River Bank will build Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin into its core banking platform, per Digital Today.

briefs.title: Ripple Treasury adds always-on returns for companies
briefs.summary: Ripple says eligible corporate customers can earn returns on qualifying digital assets, including RLUSD, and use new AI workflow tools.

briefs.title: Franklin Templeton bitcoin 'dividend reinvestment' ETFs move closer
briefs.summary: FBEQ and FIBT hold about 95% US stocks and 5% bitcoin exposure, reinvest dividends into bitcoin and charge 0.09% a year; no trading start date yet, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Trump-linked crypto firms hire lawyers and lobbyists
briefs.summary: Citing Bloomberg, ChainCatcher reports they are preparing for a possible congressional investigation after Democrats asked World Liberty Financial and 1789 Capital for information.

briefs.title: Asia-morning movers
briefs.summary: Among the top 100 coins on Tuesday morning, XDC led with +7.91% and LayerZero (ZRO) fell most, -7.14%, per IT Times.

briefs.title: Friday's options expiry in numbers
briefs.summary: CryptoTicker counts 149,686 bitcoin option contracts expiring 30 Oct with 'max pain' at $79,000. Max pain is not a price target.

briefs.title: US rule-making carries on without Congress
briefs.summary: The CFTC opened rule-making on retail crypto trading on 5 Oct, and SEC Chair Atkins said Congress was unsuccessful in advancing the CLARITY Act, per law firm Baker Botts.
